about.title: About Flame
about.story1: Flame started in 2015 with one simple idea: real fire makes real flavor. No shortcuts, no frozen patties — just handcrafted burgers and artisan pizzas over an open flame.
about.story2: Today, from our kitchen to your door, every order carries the same promise: fresh ingredients, fire-grilled to order, delivered hot.
about.value1Text: Every patty hits an open flame — never a flat-top.
about.value2Text: Produce delivered every morning, buns baked in-house.
about.value3Text: From grill to door in under 30 minutes on average.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Flame
faq.a1: We are open every day from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM. On weekends we extend until midnight.
faq.a2: Yes! We deliver within a 5 km radius of each branch. Delivery is free on orders over $25.
faq.a3: On average 25-35 minutes depending on your location and kitchen load. You can track your order live with your order number.
faq.a4: Absolutely. Look for the 🥬 badge on the menu — our Garden Veggie Burger and Margherita pizza are fan favorites.
faq.a5: Yes, use the Reserve a Table page or call your branch directly. We hold reservations for 15 minutes past booking time.
faq.q6: What allergens are in your food?
faq.a6: Common allergens like gluten, dairy, eggs and nuts are marked on each product page. Always tell our staff about severe allergies.
faq.q7: How do I use a coupon?
faq.a7: Enter your code at checkout. First order? Try WELCOME10 for 10% off.
faq.a8: Yes — from 20 to 500 guests. Contact us with your event details and we will design a custom menu.

legal.termsBody: By using the Flame website and placing an order, you agree to these terms. Orders are subject to availability. Prices include applicable taxes. We reserve the right to cancel orders in case of pricing errors or stock unavailability, with a full refund. Account holders are responsible for keeping their credentials secure.
legal.privacyBody: We collect only the data needed to fulfill your orders: name, contact details, delivery addresses and order history. We never sell your data. Payments are processed by certified providers and card details never touch our servers. You may request deletion of your account and data at any time via contact.
legal.refundBody: If an item is missing, wrong, or arrives in poor condition, contact us within 2 hours of delivery with your order number for a full or partial refund. For dine-in and pickup, refunds are handled on the spot by the branch manager. Online payment refunds reach your account within 5-10 business days.
